Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 67 Records detected", "Trading Partners 3", "Ports 7"; the free view actually displayed 5 shipment rows (1 export to Vladivostok, Russia dated 2026-02-02 with B/L 9290846; 4 import rows from Dalian/China, Gemlik & Izmit/Turkey dated 2025-12-06 to 2026-01-22 with B/Ls 7040078, 6661134, 6342472, 6128770). domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found for this entity in the sources reachable within the tool budget (DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection errors; volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403). Address on the customs record: "NEW NO.4/1M,OLD NO.3.112.2, VALLAIPILLAYAR KOVIL STREET, STREET,VELLALAPATTY, OMALUR" (Salem district, Tamil Nadu) — this is a registered-address field on a customs record, not proof of domestic supply.
note: Actual export shipment is documented: one consignment of magnesia cupels (HS 69021010 as recorded by customs, not the declared 690390) from Chennai Sea to Vladivostok, Russia, dated 2026-02-02, B/L 9290846. The company is simultaneously an importer of raw magnesite (fused/dead-burned magnesite, HS 25199010/25199020) from China and Turkey — i.e. it buys raw material and ships finished cupels out, which is consistent with a small manufacturer-exporter. Legal name claimed as "CHITHRA" is not corroborated by any record seen; the customs record shows only the trade name QUALITY ASSAY CUPELS with no legal-form suffix, so the legal entity (and its CIN/PAN) remains unverified — null. Revenue and export volume: null, not public. Domestic supply side: no traces of domestic deliveries found in the sources checked, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed; this is a gap in evidence, not a negative finding. HS note: declared 690390 (other ceramic articles) differs from the customs-recorded 69021010 (magnesia-based refractory goods) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the factual code is 69021010 and the verdict is accepted with HS correction.
